Transparent Pricing

Pricing

We do not publish a rate card, and we would be lying if we did — a roof repair on a 1970s Colonialtown bungalow and a tile re-roof in Dr. Phillips are not the same job, and no honest number covers both. What we will commit to is this: estimates are free, there is no obligation, and the price we write down after walking your property is the price you pay. One quality, one price. Below is exactly what moves that number, so you can see the logic before anyone quotes you — ours or anyone else's.

What actually drives your number

Every quote we write comes out of these variables. Ask any contractor to walk you through them; if they will not, that tells you something.

Type of workWhat the quote depends on
Roof repairSize and cause of the failure, roof material, pitch and access, whether decking underneath is wet or rotted, and how long the intrusion has been going.
Roof replacementSquares of roof area, material (asphalt, metal, tile or flat), pitch and number of penetrations, condition of the decking once the old roof is off, and disposal.
New roof installationRoof geometry and material spec, underlayment and ventilation requirements, and Florida wind-uplift code compliance for the structure.
Kitchen or bathroom remodelWhether plumbing or electrical moves, cabinetry and surface selections, floor area, and what is found once the walls are open.
Home addition or renovationSquare footage, foundation and structural work, whether the roofline changes, permitting scope, and utility runs.
New home constructionLot conditions and site prep, square footage, finish level, and the permitting path with Orange County and the City of Orlando.
Commercial construction or build-outOccupancy type and code requirements, MEP scope, permitting and inspection timeline, and whether the business stays open during the work.
Storm, water or fire damageExtent and category of the damage, how fast we got to it, drying and containment required, and how much of the rebuild is structural.

Financing and payment plan options are available on most project types — ask when we quote. Estimates are always free and never obligate you to anything.

If a contractor gives you a firm price for a re-roof over the phone without seeing the decking, they are quoting a guess and the real number arrives later. We would rather come out.

Financing available

Roofs and rebuilds rarely arrive at a convenient time. We offer payment plans and financing options so the right repair is not held up waiting on the right month. Ask us when we quote.

FAQs

Frequently asked

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes. Wolfpack Construction is a Certified General Contractor in the State of Florida, licence number CGC1531295, and we carry insurance on every job. The licence is public — you can look it up before you call us. We are also BBB Accredited with an A+ rating.

Are estimates really free?

Yes, and there is no obligation attached. We come out, look at the actual condition of your roof or space, and give you a written scope and one price. There is no hour-long presentation to sit through and no discount that expires if you do not sign that day.

Do you handle insurance claims after storm damage?

We document the damage properly and provide the assessment and scope your carrier needs. Because we hold the general contractor's licence, we can also carry the job straight through from emergency board-up and drying into the full rebuild, rather than stopping at mitigation and handing you off.

How fast can you respond to an emergency?

We respond 24/7 across Orlando and Central Florida for water, storm, fire and mold emergencies. For water intrusion, speed matters more than most people realise — Orlando's humidity means mold can establish within 24 to 48 hours of the moisture getting in.

Do you pull the permits, or do I?

We do. As a certified general contractor we manage permitting with the City of Orlando and Orange County and carry the project through final inspection and code compliance. Our roots here mean we know the local timelines and plan schedules around them.

Do you offer financing or payment plans?

Yes. Roofs and rebuilds rarely arrive at a convenient moment, so we offer payment plan and financing options. Ask when we quote and we will walk you through what is available.

What areas do you serve?

Orlando and the surrounding Central Florida communities, including Winter Park, Dr. Phillips, College Park, Baldwin Park and Lake Nona. Our office is at 2302 Mercator Drive in Orlando — we are not a national franchise dispatching crews from out of state.

Do you speak Spanish?

Yes. We speak Spanish, and you can have the whole conversation — estimate, scope, schedule and final walkthrough — in Spanish if that is easier for you.

Let's get your project moving

Free estimates, financing available, and a Florida Certified General Contractor (CGC1531295) on every job. Serving Orlando, Winter Park, Dr. Phillips, College Park, Baldwin Park and Lake Nona since 2021.
